title: Handoff Timeline Overlay: contextual SLO deltas & runbook quick-create
creator: Avery Kim
description:
Problem: On-call engineers often need a quick, contextual summary when taking over an alert: recent SLO deltas, active related alerts, recent deploys, and a fast way to create or link a runbook/postmortem. Current console flows require hopping between pages: alert detail -> SLO page -> incidents -> docs, which increases cognitive load during handoffs.

Goal: Design a lightweight, slide-over 'Handoff Timeline Overlay' that surfaces the minimal context needed for an on-call transfer or triage: SLO change sparkline with delta callout, most-relevant recent alerts, last 3 deploys (with link to rollout & canary notes), a compact actions bar (acknowledge, escalate, create runbook, attach postmortem), and an auto-generated 'handoff snippet' that can be copied to Slack or an incident ticket. The overlay should be accessible from alert cards, incident timeline entries, and the on-call rota view.
acceptance_criteria: Overlay opens from alert card, incident row, and rota view within 200ms interaction goal
SLO sparkline shows 7d trend + numeric delta compared to 24h baseline; delta color coded and accompanied by tooltip explaining calc
Quick actions include: Acknowledge, Assign, Create Runbook (pre-populated form), Link Postmortem, Copy Handoff Snippet, and Open Related Alerts (filtered)
Prototype screens available in Figma + clickable prototype demonstrating the flow from alert -> overlay -> create runbook
Design reviewed with PM and Eng and actionable feedback captured; design handoff assets (tokens, spacing, components) added to DSM
design_notes:
Key UX constraints: preserve a low visual weight so the overlay doesn't feel like a full page; prioritize critical actions for time-sensitive triage. Use a 2-column layout: left column for timeline + recent activity (alerts, deploys), right column for SLOs + actions + automated suggestions. Suggest using existing sparkline and pill component tokens from DSM to keep consistency. Accessibility: keyboard-focusable, screen reader labels for each action, and ensure color contrast for delta indicators.

Data considerations: SLO delta calc must be consistent with the SLO page; if telemetry is delayed, show an inline stale-data indicator and a refresh CTA. For runbook quick-create, prefill with alert title, top tags, and a 3-point checklist template.
decisions: Use slide-over overlay anchored to the right (not modal) to allow context of the console to remain visible
Show only top 3 related alerts by default; user can expand to see full list
Expose 'Create Runbook' as primary CTA; deeper runbook editing will open full runbook composer in a new tab
SLO delta uses 24h baseline vs 7d trend for compactness; include tooltip to deep-link to full SLO page for history
reviews: PM (Rohit Patel): requested clarifying the behavior when SLO data is missing; suggested conservative default messaging and fail-open CTA
Frontend Eng (Lena Ho): flagged potential performance issue when preloading deploy metadata; recommended lazy-loading deploy content and optimistic UI for actions
SRE (Omar Hassan): asked for inclusion of 'last remediation step' from incident notes to help faster triage
Design Lead (Clara Nguyen): approved visual direction with minor spacing tweaks; asked to add microcopy for the handoff snippet explaining what gets included
next_steps: Update prototype with lazy-loading placeholder for deploys and include stale-data indicator (by 2025-03-20)
Create DSM tokens for overlay spacing and 'delta-pill' pattern (owners: Marisol)
Sync with frontend on data contract for SLO delta and related alerts (owners: Rohit, Lena)
Prepare handoff PRD and attach Figma links + interaction spec for implementation kickoff (due 2025-03-25)
